# OneConfig
Danker's Skyblock Mod now uses [Polyfrost's OneConfig](https://github.com/Polyfrost/OneConfig/). For support with issues relating to OneConfig, join the [Polyfrost Discord server](https://polyfrost.cc/discord).
There is no version without OneConfig.

## New Features
- Remake dungeon timer, now similar to LiveSplit
  - Splits for each dungeon floor
  - Show current pace of run
  - Show sum of best splits
  - Show time difference between PB or gold splits
  - Example timer: [Image](https://i.imgur.com/5IIwgAT.png)
- Add Nutcracker and Reindrake tracking
- Waypoint features
  - Export waypoints to clipboard
  - Import Skytils/DSM/SBE/Soopy waypoints from clipboard
  - Add mining route length optimizer
- Add toggle to Crimson Isles miniboss spawning alert
- Add highlight filled bazaar orders
- Add not hiding NPC armor
- Add dungeons RNG meter tracker, with alert to abuse meter
- Add option to only show powder tracker in Dwarven Mines or Crystal Hollows
- Add carpentry to /skill and /player
- Add Inferno Demonlord to slayer highlight
- Separate X and Z coords in end of farm alert
- Add keybinds for blocking player and mouse movement
